dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Alternate personality? Don't mistake me, little miss youkai. I am Layla. I'm just "sleepwalking" right now.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: #Ah, no less than I'd expect of my dear friend, {NICKNAME}. An apt sobriquet.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Your personality is the opposite of Ms. Layla's. Almost like... a "mask" worn over her original personality.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: "A mask"? Ho, now that's an amusing way of putting it.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: How many more "masks" like you are there?

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Pfft. That's a nice pose you're striking, little miss youkai. What would you do if I were to say "more than one"?

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: My response depends on your answer. So please, do so. But let me be clear — lies are of no use here.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Oh my, how terrifying... But relax. I'm one-of-a-kind — and what's more, I'm nothing like you assume.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: At most, I help her with her homework and draw some star charts after she finally falls asleep.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: She's been pushing herself harder lately, piling more pressure on herself... Not that she'd admit it. But I know absolutely everything that goes on in her mind.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: She's clearly doing a good job, but she won't rest until she's found some flaw, even if there isn't one to find.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: ...Such intense introjected aggression. Does Ms. Layla rarely receive positive feedback in her daily life?

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: The opposite. Her advisor and classmates all praise her to the skies.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: But "she" ignores what she's already accomplished, fixating instead on every little imperfection or unfilled gap.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: ...I understand. I'll adjust her treatment plan accordingly going forward.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Just a word of caution. If Miss Layla does recover, you will disappear.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Is that so? Great. Looking forward to it.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: What, confused? Little miss youkai, I am Layla. I always have been.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Rather than "disappearing"... It'd just be the "mask" being dropped.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, would you mind supporting me a bit? I think... she's about ready to wake.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Huh...? I... Wh—What?

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Thank you... I—I'm supposed to be receiving therapy right now, right? I'm not... I didn't sleepwalk again, did I?

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Miss Mizuki! I didn't say anything rude, or do anything I shouldn't have... did I...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: No, you didn't. Please relax. You did, however, suddenly wake up during the treatment. It gave me quite a start.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: I'm sorry... It must be because I've barely slept these past few weeks. As soon as I stop sleeping well, I start sleepwalking.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: In that case, how do you feel now, after that little rest?

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Huh? Mm... I slept well, and I don't feel dizzy. My vision isn't blurry, either.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: But I did have a very strange dream. In it, someone was sitting next to me. I couldn't see her face, but she was holding my hand the whole time.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: She seemed to be saying something, but I couldn't hear it. I just felt like... her presence comforted me. I...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: It's okay, that's enough for now.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Dreams are cherry blossoms carried by a swift current. Thinking of them fondly from time to time is fine, but should you try to reach out and grab them...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: ...Alright. I understand.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: In that case, today's session is concluded. Please return tomorrow at the same time, Miss Layla, and please be punctual.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: #Y—Yes! Thank you, and thank you for supporting me just now, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Okay, I'll be going now. Hmm... You know, I think I can write a great abstract now!
